tei:div.tei:p: “Sabbath Blessing” by Caroline de Litchfield Harby (ca.1800-1876), is included in the so-called Isaac Harby Prayerbook (ca. 1825, facsimile ed. 1974) also known as the Cohn Lithograph, a handwritten prayerbook containing the prayers offered by the Reformed Society of Israel in Charleston, South Carolina in the 1820s.
